name: Credential Mask
description: Prevent credentials and secret keys from being exported via config-sync processes.
project_description: Credential Mask hooks into Drupal's configuration-management storage-transform events so that configuration keys you mark as sensitive (API keys, secret keys, passwords, tokens) are replaced with a static placeholder in the exported config-sync YAML, keeping them out of files committed to version control. On import, the placeholder is transparently swapped back for the real value read from active storage, so importing masked config never overwrites the live secret. Which config names and keys are treated as sensitive is a list you maintain — via the settings form at /admin/config/development/configuration/credential_mask (gated by the core 'import configuration' permission) or via Drush commands (credential_mask:add, :del, :list, :show-configuration). Wildcards ('*') are supported in config names. The module does not encrypt or relocate secrets: values remain in Drupal's active (database) config as before; it only controls what appears in the exported YAML. Requires Drush 10+ for the CLI/config-sync integration; conflicts with drupal/config_filter <2 and drush/drush <10.
